messages:
maria: Quick sync — webinar scheduled Wed 10am PT but we also have multiple analyst briefings Tue/Wed. Need a concrete plan for: 1) routing inbound press/analyst Qs during launch window, 2) who owns fact-check for the benchmark numbers in the blog/press release. Can we assign? @alex @kyle

alex: I can own the benchmark fact-check (throughput + cost numbers). Will validate perf tables and call out any caveats.

kyle: I can help with eval methodology notes and provide a short FAQ snippet we can hand to press. Will pull the eval notebooks.

sam: Who's triaging live press emails/Slack pings during Wed? We should route to a single inbox + on-call person to avoid duplicated answers.

maria: Plan: route all press@ -> sam for triage. Sam will escalate technical Qs to alex/kyle and product Qs to erin. I'll create a one-page press cheat sheet. Sound good? :thumbsup:

erin: SGTM. I can be on-call Wed 9:30–11:30 PT for product questions. Please add me to the calendar invite.

sam: I'll own press@ triage Wed 9–12 PT. Can someone drop the contact + rapid FAQ into the sheet? Link: https://docs.redwood.ai/launch-press-routes (please use the 'PR live' tab)

alex: Adding a quick data caveat snippet below — please paste into FAQ where relevant:

```
Benchmarks measured on dedicated A100s, 2k token context, n=20 runs. Variance +/- 5% depending on model variant and quantization. Customer results may vary with different workloads.
```

kyle: I'll prepare the eval-methods bullet list (short) and paste to the same sheet. Also will flag any numbers that need secondary validation before we send to reporters.

maria: Timeline: get cheat sheet + FAQ in sheet by EOD today so PR can prep embargo email. Sam, please confirm you have cover for overflow (in case of >2 queries/min).

sam: I can take overflow for first hour; will ask @devops_oncall to pick up if volume spikes. Also setting a Slack channel #press-live for immediate escalations.

pressbot: Reminder — embargo window opens Tue 09:00 PT. Auto-create calendar invites for folks tagged in this thread.

maria: Awesome — I'll finalize copy and post the embargo email draft by 17:00. If anyone finds a data caveat that isn't covered, ping me ASAP.

erin: FYI, webinar panelist asked for a single-sentence marketing claim we can vet: "Redwood reduces per-token cost by 40% vs baseline." Alex/kyle — can you confirm we can use that phrasing?

alex: 40% is OK as a median observed in our benchmark set but needs the caveat that it's vs baseline-quant config X. Suggest: "Median token cost reduction of ~40% vs baseline config X (results vary by workload)."

kyle: Agree with alex. I'll add the exact baseline config to the FAQ and put a one-line parenthetical for press.

maria: Perfect. Last ask — can we run a 15-min dry run Tues 4pm PT for triage flow + calendar invites? I want to ensure routing + escalation works before publish.

sam: I’ll be there. Erin, alex, kyle, can you do 4pm?

erin: Yep.

alex: Yes.

kyle: Yes.

maria: Great — dry run confirmed. I'll send invites and update the sheet. Thanks all! :rocket:
